sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases ATK and MATK by 160% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases ATK buff limit by 80% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases MATK buff limit by 80% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 90 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
-Applies Revolutionary Element (increases max HP by 100%, increases all stats by 100%, increases Ability Power of critical hits by 30, and reduces Ability Cost consumption by 50%) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 40.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
Fire and Wind Defense from Unison Damage +500

[Tutor-Slash-Maid] Sylpha or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
